scope: desktop and Android player-facing World and Play surfaces
player_behavior: Desktop Play no longer displays chapter IDs, state revision numbers, or before/after revision transitions.
Inventory entries resolve resource IDs through the World presentation map and display natural resource names.
Relationship audit reason keys stay internal; missing relationship, route, resource, and chapter labels use natural fallback copy instead of raw IDs.
Rollback records resolve their target to a natural turn number instead of exposing a Turn ID prefix.
Desktop and Android World details describe saved Runs as journeys in progress or completed, without exposing revision or Run ID fragments.
Desktop compose confirmation describes saved world content and a prepared first journey instead of showing aggregate IDs.

contract_change.run_presentation_resources: RunSnapshot.presentation now includes the shared resource ID to display-name map; revision remains available internally for optimistic concurrency.

not_proven: The rebuilt macOS packaged WebView has not completed visual A-F acceptance.
Android physical-device visual and TalkBack behavior remain open because adb has no connected device.
Windows native packaging and player journey remain open.
